dct_title_s: [Plan des terreins appartenant aux francais autour de Fort de Pontchartrain].
dct_description_sm: Negative photostatic copy of a 1912 copy from the Burton Historical Collection, Detroit, Michigan. Burton call no. 977.4 D4 F77H [1707?].; MiU copy varies slightly from ill. in Dunnigan.; "True copy of plan in the Dominion Archives, Ottawa, Nicole R. Trudeau, 31 March, 1912." Dominion Archives copy may be a manuscript copy of the original at the Center des Archives d'outre mer, Aix-en-Provence, Archives nationales, France.; Shows lands near Fort Pontchartrain allotted to French settlers of Detroit, with names of some noted on properties.; Shows relationship of village and lands of Huron Indians to those of French settlers.
